changes.text: `mdg setup codex` must install or update the bundled Skill, a managed Markdown Gatekeeper bootstrap block in the user's Codex `AGENTS.md`, and a stable launcher under the Codex home directory.
changes.previousText: `mdg setup codex` must install or update both the bundled Skill and a managed Markdown Gatekeeper bootstrap block in the user's Codex `AGENTS.md`.

changes.text: The Skill must try global `mdg` first. If it is unavailable, it must use the managed launcher under the Codex home directory before considering a verified repository-local `node ./bin/mdg.mjs`; it must never generate a predictable failed command merely to probe availability.
changes.previousText: The Skill must use global `mdg` directly. It may fall back to `node ./bin/mdg.mjs` only after the global command is unavailable and the local file is verified to exist; it must never generate a predictable failed command merely to probe availability.

changes.text: The managed launcher must use absolute package and Node paths so Codex GUI sessions work even when macOS does not expose npm's global executable directory through `PATH`.
Installation must refuse to overwrite an unmanaged Skill or launcher unless `--force` is explicit.
changes.previousText: Installation must refuse to overwrite an unmanaged Skill unless `--force` is explicit.

changes.text: `mdg setup status` must report CLI version, Skill version, Skill path, stable launcher path, global `AGENTS.md` path, and whether the global bootstrap and launcher are installed.
changes.previousText: `mdg setup status` must report CLI version, Skill version, Skill path, global `AGENTS.md` path, and whether the global bootstrap is installed.

changes.text: Tests must prove that installation is idempotent, preserves unrelated global instructions, migrates the prior unmarked block, leaves unmanaged projects untouched, installs quiet zero-touch bootstrap instructions, and creates a working stable launcher without relying on the caller's `PATH`.
changes.previousText: Tests must prove that installation is idempotent, preserves unrelated global instructions, migrates the prior unmarked block, leaves unmanaged projects untouched, and installs quiet zero-touch bootstrap instructions.
